ctx.x: And I couldn't -- it was very difficult for me to play clarinet, that's why I played soprano, I couldn't learn the clarinet at all. So I learned the soprano saxophone and I played it -- I was -- I played it in the style of clarinet, fast running styles like Jimmy Noon and
Barney Bigard, I played that type on the soprano saxophone, and it was very well received everywhere.
